rows.notes: The study is labelled 'Review' and is a descriptive overview of climate change impacts in the Czech Republic and of the CzechGlobe research infrastructure (ICOS, ACTRIS, ANAEE, SustES, InterSucho, etc.). It reports no own experiment, survey, dataset or model run on soil moisture monitoring or drought-tolerant crops and farm resilience; the only data figure (Fig. 3, NEP courses) is unpublished data from another team and unrelated to the claim. InterSucho is described as providing drought/water-balance data and irrigation guidance, but no result on farm resilience is reported. Q1 is 'no', so Q2-Q9 are 'no'.
